dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Strongly falcate curvature; the trailing edge exhibits a deep concave spline from the apex to the posterior base insertion.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex with a moderate pixel radius; lacks acute or sharpened morphological peaking.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 45-degree linear incline relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge line.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.4:1 ratio of maximum horizontal base width to vertical apex height.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Minor jagged irregularity and possible nicking located at the extreme posterior margin where the trailing edge meets the peduncle ridge.
